explanation: I searched Mathlib for other AEStronglyMeasurable lemmas about f / g or f - g. The only division lemma besides the target is AEStronglyMeasurable.div₀. It assumes GroupWithZero, ContinuousInv₀ and MetrizableSpace, so it does not apply to a topological group. The subtraction lemma AEStronglyMeasurable.sub is generated from the target by to_additive, so it does not count. The general lemma Continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable₂ would need continuity of (x, y) ↦ x / y, which is a derivation of the target rather than an existing statement of it. I found no separate declaration that states the target.
